A '''knockout grenade''' was a type of [[Grenade/Legends|grenade]]. While [[Stun/Legends|stun]] weapons were the most common nonlethal means of disabling an adversary, they were not the only option for subduing an opponent. Knockout grenades offered a method to incapacitate multiple targets without causing permanent harm. These grenades released a [[tranquilizer]] gas that swiftly put most living beings within the blast radius into a deep sleep. Poachers occasionally used such grenades to capture wild, dangerous predators, and they could also effectively subdue large creatures if used in sufficient quantities.<ref name="Fly" />
